$comment: §5 — the PlayContext GAMEPLAY payload: episode-static facts, one byte string built once per seat, handed unchanged to play_init and to the socket packet (the control envelope travels beside it as a separate slice). Cap: MaxContextBytes (65536). Deliberately atlas-free and raster-free: goal validation and cover queries are host functions (§5/§6.1), so the maximum is a constant of the roster and map dimensions. Complete at first registration: with the roster closed by configuration (§5.1), everything here is a function of configuration alone, unchanged by lobby leaves or process replacement.
title: play_context

mode.$comment: derived server-side (§5.1), never declared; also exposed to guards as mode.is_ctf / mode.is_koth / mode.is_br

name.$comment: the resolved map identity (mapPath, or gen:<seed> / pool:<idx>)

roster.$comment: the complete configured closed roster (§5.1), seat order; 2..32 entries

control.$comment: omit when input — so a play can tell play seats from legacy seats

duo_partner.$comment: the partner seat; present exactly in mode br, where a duo IS the two configured seats of one team (§5.1)

gun_range.$comment: the LIVE per-map weapon range (config.gunRange), never a constant (§4.2)
